content: Asyääl a Nzam
Akà mɛ, atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwe anki muyäm anà bɛ asànaa akà baar a dweelà, wɛɛ asànaa akà baar a imbuur, asànaa akà baan ambɛy abà amu Klistɔ.
Mɛ amàlapà an'bɛɛl munwà, kà isaa a bwoor anki, ntɔn bɛ làlàkwo anki anà bya. Itàkal apanà, bɛ làkwo anki,
ntɔn tii lalà bɛ làbà unsà imbuur. Ntɔn uboo a bɛ un'köl anà an'sye mà mwo, nkye nsyääl abɛ kà yà imbuur anki?
Mpal ufàtɛn mbuur mwɛy uboo a bɛ naa: « Mɛ in'wà mbuur a Pɔl », wumwɛy naa: « Mɛ in'wà wà Apɔlɔs! », nkye abun bɛ làfàkyer anki unsà imbuur?
Asyääl a Nzam
Abun, Apɔlɔs ininà? Pɔl ininà? Asyääl: u mbwo a ba, bɛ làsi làkwikilà. Umwɛy umwɛy kàkyer asànaa an'kab kun'pɛ Mwol.
Mɛ, mɛ kàkön, Apɔlɔs waa kàtsüül an'dà, wɛɛ Nzam kàkyer ngyɛɛl.
Kyakin, mbuur afàkɔn anà mbuur afàtsuul an'dà, ba ndöŋ yatɛy, Nzam mpɛl awà ndöŋ, ntɔn Nde afàsà ngyɛɛl.
Mbuur afàkɔn anà afàtsuul bà mbwo mwɛy, ntɔn mbuur mbuur asàwal làfur ande unsà isii a isal ande ŋakwo.
Ntɔn bi ibà mbaay unsà isal a Nzam anà bɛ làbà ywaŋ ande. Bɛ sye làbà ndwà utɔŋà Nzam.
U mbwo a kab a ngway kan'pɛ Nzam, asànaa un'tööŋ aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàsi un'bään, mbuur asin an'yàtɔŋ udu a wa. Wɛɛ, wɛy mbuur mbuur ukäl kà igyɛɛŋ unsà ntööŋ ande.
Wɛy mbuur asin ukɔ̈ɔ̈n afàsà un'bään asin ukɔl a un'bään awà paa: Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kyekà, itàkal naa ban'tɔŋ udu a un'bään awà anà wɔl, arza, in'kul a ntal, in'te, in'lɛŋ, wɛŋwɛŋ,
isal a mbuur mbuur ikyer asàmɛnà. Ilä a nsaŋ isàmɛɛy kya, ntɔn kya ifàmɛnà u mbaa. Mbaa isàsi isal a mbuur mbuur ntɔn muswaŋ ntal a kya.
Isàkal naa isal a mbuur kàtöŋ udu a un'bään kyan'tsim u mbaa, nde asàwal làfur.
Isàkal naa kya kyan'kuŋà, nde undiir usàwal anki. Nde ŋakwo asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ asànaa mbuur kan'sɔrà u mbaa.
Nkye bɛ làyöb anki naa bɛ làbà ndwà a Nzam anà Dweelà a Nzam làfàkal uboo a bɛ?
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'dwa ndwà a Nzam, Nzam akyer asun'dwa. Ntɔn ndwà a Nzam yà in'kyɛɛl, bɛ làbà ndwà a Nzam ya.
Wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akur nde ŋàkwo: isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy uboo a bɛ akakyeyà uyɔl naa nde wà ŋayeerà u mɛɛn mà, wɛy nde ubulà ŋukɔŋ, ntɔn mubulà ŋayeerà.
Ntɔn an'yeerà a mɛɛn mà, mà ukɔŋ kusà a Nzam. Kyakin, bàsön naa: « Nde afàwal aŋayeerà unsà impeenà aba ŋakwo. »
Anà sye naa: « Mwol akyàyöb an'kyän a aŋayeerà, nde akyàyöb naa ma mà bunàbun. »
Abun, mbuur taaŋ aswaŋ tɛy ngaal ande udu a baar, ntɔn indiir byanswà byà bɛ:
Pɔl, Apɔlɔs itàkal Sɛfas, mɛɛn, mɔ̈ɔ̈ itàkal ukwà, apanà itàkal ungö, bya byanswà byà bɛ,
wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làbà bà Klistɔ, anà Klistɔ wà wà Nzam.
